Publish the Simple Hackintosh CLI v2.5.2 release from the main branch.
The release ZIP includes the CMD, PowerShell and macOS Terminal launchers, cross-platform hardware inventory, automatic Windows OpCore-Simplify Hardware Sniffer report export with official GitHub SHA-256 verification and optional Authenticode checking, Windows console-safe progress output, EFI checks, and the macrecovery downloader source only; Apple Recovery payloads are not included.
